title: Implement Support for HTTPS
description: This feature matters because it enables yantraverse to serve secure content, protecting user data and preventing man-in-the-middle attacks, by adding support for HTTPS protocol. It does this by integrating TLS/SSL certificates and handling encryption. This improves the overall security of the framework.
testCases: Test HTTPS connection with valid certificate
Test HTTPS connection with invalid certificate
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can successfully serve content over HTTPS and handle TLS/SSL certificates correctly, without disrupting existing HTTP functionality.
reason: Implementing HTTPS support is a high-impact feature that significantly improves the security and trustworthiness of yantraverse, making it more attractive to developers who require a secure production-ready framework.
